verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Restate ships as a single self-contained binary with no external dependencies, and that it can run as a single- or multi-node cluster on a local machine, VM, or Kubernetes. The hosting overview lists 'operate Restate yourself' (OSS) alongside Cloud and BYOC, and the server code is public on GitHub. Missing for 10: detailed independent hands-on reports of self-hosting a production cluster, and clarity on licensing, since the community notes the server is BSL-licensed rather than OSI open source, which may matter for an openness-focused user.
